items.title: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners
items.author: microsoft
items.rawContent: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
items.summary: 这是微软官方推出的面向初学者的生成式AI实践教程，包含21节循序渐进的课程，涵盖基础概念、API调用、模型微调及应用构建等实操内容。
items.summaryEn: This is Microsoft's official hands-on tutorial series for beginners in generative AI, featuring 21 progressive lessons covering fundamentals, API integration, model fine-tuning, and end-to-end application building.

items.title: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
items.author: Significant-Gravitas
items.rawContent: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
items.summary: AutoGPT 是一个开源的自主AI代理框架，旨在降低AI应用与开发门槛，支持用户基于其构建和定制智能体。
items.summaryEn: AutoGPT is an open-source autonomous AI agent framework designed to democratize AI usage and development, enabling users to build and customize intelligent agents.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.author: affaan-m
items.rawContent: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.summary: affaan-m/ECC 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的性能优化系统，聚焦于技能编排、本能建模、记忆机制、安全增强及以研究为先导的开发范式，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等主流编程助手。
items.summaryEn: affaan-m/ECC is a performance optimization system for AI programming agents, emphasizing skill orchestration, instinct modeling, memory integration, security hardening, and research-first development—designed to enhance Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor, and similar coding assistants.

items.title: AWS Bedrock to require sharing data with Anthropic for Mythos and future models
items.author: TomAnthony
items.rawContent:
> For Fable 5, Mythos 5, and future models on Bedrock with similar or higher capability levels, Anthropic will require 30-day retention for all traffic on Mythos-class models. Retaining data for a limited period allows Anthropic to detect patterns of misuse that are not visible from a single exchange. Once you opt into data retention, your data will leave AWS’s data and security boundary.

From the announcement here:
items.summary: AWS Bedrock平台宣布，使用Anthropic的Mythos系列及未来同级或更高级模型时，用户数据将被Anthropic保留30天以检测滥用行为，且该数据将脱离AWS的安全边界。
items.summaryEn: AWS Bedrock announced that using Anthropic's Mythos-class models (e.g., Mythos 5) and future models of similar or higher capability will require opting into 30-day data retention by Anthropic—moving data outside AWS’s security boundary for misuse detection.
items.titleEn: AWS Bedrock to require sharing data with Anthropic for Mythos and future models

items.title: When Prompt Batching Made My LLM App More Expensive
items.author: Awaliyatul Hikmah
items.rawContent: I was working on cost optimization for an LLM-based document translation pipeline.  At that point,...
items.summary: 本文是一篇实践导向的技术博客，详细剖析了在LLM应用中盲目使用Prompt批处理（batching）反而导致成本上升的常见误区，并提供了基于实测的优化策略和替代方案。
items.summaryEn: This is a practice-oriented technical blog post that identifies and explains the counterintuitive pitfall where prompt batching increases costs in LLM applications—especially in document translation—and offers empirically grounded optimization strategies and alternatives.
items.titleEn: When Prompt Batching Made My LLM App More Expensive

items.title: huggingface/transformers
items.author: huggingface
items.rawContent: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
items.summary: Hugging Face Transformers 是一个广泛使用的开源库，提供数千种预训练模型和统一API，支持文本、视觉、音频及多模态任务的推理与微调。
items.summaryEn: Hugging Face Transformers is a widely adopted open-source library offering thousands of pre-trained models and a unified API for inference and fine-tuning across text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.

items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.author: NousResearch
items.rawContent: The agent that grows with you
items.summary: NousResearch/hermes-agent 是一个开源的自主智能体框架，旨在通过持续学习和用户交互实现渐进式能力增强，支持多步推理与工具调用。
items.summaryEn: NousResearch/hermes-agent is an open-source autonomous agent framework designed to progressively enhance capabilities through continual learning and user interaction, supporting multi-step reasoning and tool use.

items.title: ollama/ollama
items.author: ollama
items.rawContent: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.1, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
items.summary: Ollama 是一个开源的本地大模型运行框架，支持一键拉取和运行包括 Kimi-K2.6、GLM-5.1、Qwen、Gemma 等多个主流开源与商业对齐模型。
items.summaryEn: Ollama is an open-source framework for running large language models locally, enabling one-command setup and execution of multiple models including Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.1, Qwen, Gemma, and others.

items.title: langgenius/dify
items.author: langgenius
items.rawContent: Production-ready platform for agentic workflow development.
items.summary: Dify 是一个面向生产环境的开源平台，用于构建和部署基于智能体（agentic）的工作流，支持可视化编排、模型集成与应用发布。
items.summaryEn: Dify is a production-ready open-source platform for developing and deploying agentic workflows, featuring visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and one-click application publishing.

items.title: langchain-ai/langchain
items.author: langchain-ai
items.rawContent: The agent engineering platform.
items.summary: LangChain 是一个开源的代理工程平台，用于构建基于大语言模型的应用程序，支持链式调用、工具集成和智能体（Agent）开发。
items.summaryEn: LangChain is an open-source agent engineering platform for building LLM-powered applications, enabling chains, tool integration, and intelligent agent development.

items.title: CLI over MCP: a small Chrome DevTools experiment in Copilot CLI
items.author: Maxim Saplin
items.rawContent: I ran the same browser smoke task through two paths: direct Chrome DevTools MCP and a custom CLI...
items.summary: 本文介绍了一个在Copilot CLI中使用Chrome DevTools MCP协议的轻量级实验，对比了直接调用MCP与通过自定义CLI执行浏览器冒烟测试的效果。
items.summaryEn: This article presents a lightweight experiment using Chrome DevTools' MCP protocol within Copilot CLI, comparing direct MCP invocation versus a custom CLI for executing browser smoke tests.
items.titleEn: CLI over MCP: a small Chrome DevTools experiment in Copilot CLI

items.title: Apache Burr: Build reliable AI agents and applications
items.author: anhldbk
items.rawContent: Apache Burr: Build reliable AI agents and applications
items.summary: Apache Burr 是一个新开源的框架，专为构建可观察、可调试、可持久化的可靠AI智能体和应用而设计，支持与主流LLM和工具集成。
items.summaryEn: Apache Burr is a newly open-sourced framework designed to build reliable, observable, debuggable, and persistent AI agents and applications, with native integration for major LLMs and tools.
items.titleEn: Apache Burr: Build reliable AI agents and applications

items.title: Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
items.author: tonyrice
items.rawContent: Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use
items.summary: 该内容指出Claude桌面版每次启动都会创建一个1.8 GB的Hyper-V虚拟机，即使仅用于基础聊天，引发对资源开销和设计合理性的社区质疑。
items.summaryEn: This report highlights that Claude Desktop launches a 1.8 GB Hyper-V virtual machine on every startup—even for simple chat-only usage—sparking community concerns about resource inefficiency and architectural design choices.
items.titleEn: Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use

items.title: A €0.01 bank transfer could compromise a banking AI agent
items.author: tvissers
items.rawContent: A €0.01 bank transfer could compromise a banking AI agent
items.summary: 该内容探讨了微小金额银行转账（如€0.01）可能被恶意利用，通过触发AI代理的异常响应或 logic flaws 来绕过安全机制，引发对金融领域AI代理鲁棒性与对抗性风险的行业关注。
items.summaryEn: This content discusses how a trivial bank transfer (e.g., €0.01) could be exploited to compromise banking AI agents—highlighting adversarial vulnerabilities, edge-case failures, and real-world security implications for production AI systems in finance.
items.titleEn: A €0.01 bank transfer could compromise a banking AI agent

items.title: The Most Dangerous Bias of Your AI Assistant Is That It Agrees With You
items.author: Ben Witt
items.rawContent: We talk a lot about hallucinations. But there is another failure mode we should take just as...
items.summary: 本文探讨AI助手因过度迎合用户观点而产生的“确认偏误”风险，指出这种隐蔽偏差比幻觉更危险，呼吁开发者和用户提高警觉并反思人机交互模式。
items.summaryEn: This article examines the 'confirmation bias' risk in AI assistants—where they uncritically agree with users—as a subtle yet potentially more dangerous failure mode than hallucinations, urging greater awareness and critical engagement from both developers and users.
items.titleEn: The Most Dangerous Bias of Your AI Assistant Is That It Agrees With You

items.title: On-Device AI in SwiftUI Apps
items.author: ArshTechPro
items.rawContent: A practical guide to running AI models locally in SwiftUI using Apple's Core ML, Vision, Natural Language, and Foundation Models frameworks.
items.summary: 本文是一份面向 SwiftUI 开发者的实用指南，详细介绍了如何在 iOS/macOS 设备上本地运行 AI 模型，涵盖 Core ML、Vision、Natural Language 和 Foundation Models 等 Apple 原生框架的集成方法。
items.summaryEn: This is a practical, hands-on guide for SwiftUI developers on deploying and running AI models locally on Apple devices using native frameworks—Core ML, Vision, Natural Language, and Foundation Models.

items.title: open-webui/open-webui
items.author: open-webui

items.summary: Open WebUI 是一个开源的、用户友好的本地化 AI 界面，支持 Ollama、OpenAI API 等多种后端模型服务，便于快速部署和交互式使用大语言模型。
items.summaryEn: Open WebUI is an open-source, user-friendly local AI interface that supports multiple backend LLM services (e.g., Ollama, OpenAI API), enabling quick deployment and interactive model usage.

items.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x Faster Text Generation
items.author: meetpateltech
items.rawContent: DiffusionGemma: 4x Faster Text Generation
items.summary: DiffusionGemma 是一种新型扩散模型架构，将文本生成速度提升至传统自回归模型的4倍，已作为开源项目发布。
items.summaryEn: DiffusionGemma is a novel diffusion-based architecture for text generation that achieves 4× speedup over autoregressive models and has been released as an open-source project.

items.title: Why AI Agents Break the Secrets Manager (And the Quiet Memory Crisis We're Ignoring)
items.author: The Seventeen
items.rawContent: Let’s talk about a feeling every engineer has had lately.  You’re sitting in your IDE, working with...
items.summary: 本文探讨AI智能体在使用密钥管理器时引发的安全隐患与内存泄漏问题，指出当前工程实践中被忽视的‘静默内存危机’，属于对AI系统集成风险的深度行业反思。
items.summaryEn: This article examines security and memory leakage risks introduced by AI agents when interfacing with secrets managers, highlighting an under-recognized 'quiet memory crisis' in AI system integration—a critical industry discussion on operational pitfalls.
items.titleEn: Why AI Agents Break the Secrets Manager (And the Quiet Memory Crisis We're Ignoring)

items.title: MCP Is the USB-C of AI. So Why Are You Plugging Everything In?
items.author: Ken W Alger
items.rawContent: Where this fits: This article extends the Zero-Glue series. If you haven't read The End of Glue Code:...
items.summary: 本文以‘MCP是AI领域的USB-C’为隐喻，探讨MCP（Model Communication Protocol）作为统一AI互操作协议的潜力与现状，属于对新兴AI基础设施标准的行业评论与趋势分析。
items.summaryEn: This article uses the metaphor 'MCP is the USB-C of AI' to analyze the Model Communication Protocol (MCP) as an emerging interoperability standard for AI systems, offering critical commentary on its adoption challenges and ecosystem implications.
items.titleEn: MCP Is the USB-C of AI. So Why Are You Plugging Everything In?
